decided_by: Agent session for Alexander Kell (epic #880, issue #1095, lead decision L-74); review in the pull request decides
rationale: AD-406: with --native-core, a TypeScript report asks the core to run the collector in its own process (the scan request). One contract change follows from it and from nothing else: the new module archkeel.cli.native_scan (the scan request, the field-by-field comparison of the derived request with the request of the shell, and the exchange with the core) joins the exact modules of the composition component of cli, beside archkeel.cli.native_core and archkeel.cli.core_frame. It adds no requires entry, no public name and no budget: the calls_unresolved budget of the baseline goes down from 1028 to 1027, and typing_positions stays at 71.
